description: This file contains an abstract base class for HTML attribute definitions used in HTMLPurifier, a PHP library for sanitizing HTML input. The class provides methods for validation, cleaning, and parsing attribute data, serving as the foundational class for various attribute validators within the library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining and validating HTML attribute data, providing common validation and parsing methods for subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Abstract method to validate and possibly clean a string attribute value.

methods.name: parseCDATA
methods.description: Processes a string as CDATA by trimming whitespace, removing line feeds, and replacing carriage returns and tabs with spaces.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to create an attribute definition object from a string, defaulting to returning the current instance.

methods.name: mungeRgb
methods.description: Removes spaces from rgb() or hsl() color definitions to support CSS shorthand notation, with special handling for rgba() and hsla().

methods.name: expandCSSEscape
methods.description: Parses a CSS string with escape sequences and returns the unescaped, 'pure' version of the string.
